metadata.purpose: PA-GEO-04 manual geometry and OSM-lineage inspection sample
metadata.method: Records intersecting the study area, one stratum each by first matching rule; at least 3 per non-empty stratum, the rest of 80 by largest remainder in proportion to stratum size; within a stratum, ascending sha256(seed:snapshot_id:ACTIVETRANSPORTID).

unofficial_connection.rule: City's unofficial driveway and on-road connections

unresolved_semantics.rule: records whose physical or virtual nature the source leaves ambiguous

curb_cut_coded.rule: CURBCUT = Y (a curbcut down to street level)

not_along_osm_pedestrian_way.rule: pedestrian record with a point 20 m or more from any OSM footway, path, pedestrian way or steps

offset_from_osm_pedestrian_way.rule: pedestrian record whose worst point is 3-20 m from OSM pedestrian ways

merged_looking.rule: multi-part or at least 400 m long

split_looking.rule: shorter than 5 m without a curb-cut code

dense_core_sidewalk.rule: sidewalk in the densest tenth of the inventory in the study area

parallel_sidewalk_pair.rule: sidewalk whose road segment has sidewalks on both sides

residential_sidewalk.rule: sidewalk whose nearest OSM road is residential

other_physical.rule: cycling, maintenance and remaining physical records

metadata.coordinates: OGC:CRS84, rounded to 7 decimal places (about 1 cm) for inspection
